disclaimer: This is a deterministic product-model baseline for prototype testing. It is not a molecular simulation, safety assessment, professional perfumery conclusion, or production formula.

pair_relation_policy.activation: both components active and min(perceived_share_source, perceived_share_target) >= threshold, except masking which uses source share >= threshold

masking.aggregation: multiply all active target factors, then renormalize all perceived contributions once

synergy.attribute_delta: add effect to every affected core attribute

conflict.core_attribute_delta: for affected core attributes, subtract effect * 0.5

attributes.finalization: apply relation deltas then clamp to 0..1

complexity.entropy: if component_count <= 1 then 0 else -sum(n_i * ln(n_i)) / ln(component_count)

clarity.formula: clamp(0.30 * dominance + 0.20 * family_coherence + 0.20 * continuity + 0.15 * stage_balance + 0.15 * low_masking - conflict_penalty - theme_penalty + group_clarity_delta)

balance.overload_penalty: sum(abs(group clarity delta) for active overload or homogeneity group rules)

group_rule_policy.active_component: component is in group and perceived share > 0
group_rule_policy.combined_effective_share: sum perceived shares of group members
group_rule_policy.conditions_source: final core attributes before group deltas
group_rule_policy.effects: apply clarity_delta and complexity_delta exactly once per active group rule

problem_detection.too_sweet: sweetness >= 0.78 and sweet_heavy share >= 0.35, unless too_sweet_heavy already active
problem_detection.too_heavy: weight >= 0.78 and transparency <= 0.28, unless dark_heavy_overload already active
problem_detection.middle_missing: heart stage share < 0.18 or heart stage primary share < 0.25
problem_detection.too_many_themes: active family count >= 5 or (active family count >= 4 and clarity < 0.45 and complexity > 0.65)
problem_detection.cold_warm_tension: REL-027 active or (freshness >= 0.65 and warmth >= 0.65 and conflict_penalty > 0)
problem_detection.pair_conflict: one or more conflict relations active

confidence.external_material_override: external material data quality and mapping quality replace built-in defaults; incomplete external material must not receive high confidence

determinism.same_input_same_versions: byte-equivalent numeric output after canonical key ordering and API rounding

canonicalization.component_order: sort by component id before hashing
